new_page.title: BC Real Estate Questions: Taxes, Down Payment & More
new_page.description: Quick answers on property transfer tax, the speculation tax, flipping tax, FHSA, down payments, assessments and the 3-day rescission period in BC.

parts.t: Short, sourced answers to the questions buyers and sellers in South Surrey, White Rock, Langley and the Fraser Valley ask most. Each page answers in the first paragraph, then shows the numbers and links to the official source.
